body_markdown: Researcher-0009 strengthens the graph-only warning: one connected full-support carrier simultaneously attains every point- and line-star lower envelope, has fractional reaching optimum $\Theta(\vartheta p/\epsilon)$, and has the perfect decoder $Q=0$. Its auxiliary DRC estimate must also pay the concurrency correction in `IE-L-AUXILIARY-DRC`; at the cubic scale the resulting density-only root-rich bound is trivial. These are method barriers, not counterexamples to the target.
subject: Sharper graph-only ceiling
